description.en: Renames downloaded files using a template ({{title}}, {{ext}}, {{date}}, {{id}}) before they are finalized.
description.zh: 在完成下载前按模板（{{title}}、{{ext}}、{{date}}、{{id}}）重命名文件。

en: Renames finished downloads from a configurable template
Works with HTTP, FTP and BitTorrent downloads
Applies before the file is finalized on disk
zh: 按可配置模板重命名已完成的下载
支持 HTTP、FTP 与 BitTorrent 下载
在文件最终落盘前执行
